description: This file defines the React component 'CompletedTasksPage', which renders the layout for displaying completed tasks in a To-Do application. It imports other components such as StatusBar, NavigationBar, and TaskCard, and uses props to supply a list of completed tasks and optionally a custom navigation component.

methods.name: CompletedTasksPage({ NavigationBarComponent, todos = [] })
methods.description: React functional component that renders the completed tasks page, including headers, a list of task cards, and a bottom navigation bar.
